Ternary Contour Plot

Source: vignettes/articles/r-docs/ternary-contour.Rmd
ternary-contour.Rmd

Basic Terary Contour Plot 

library(plotly.core)
library(jsonlite)

df <- fromJSON(
  "https://gist.githubusercontent.com/davenquinn/988167471993bc2ece29/raw/f38d9cb3dd86e315e237fde5d65e185c39c931c2/data.json",
  simplifyVector = FALSE
)

colors <- c("#8dd3c7", "#ffffb3", "#bebada",
            "#fb8072", "#80b1d3", "#fdb462",
            "#b3de69", "#fccde5", "#d9d9d9",
            "#bc80bd", "#ccebc5", "#ffed6f")

fig <- go_figure()

for (i in seq_along(df)) {
  l <- sapply(df[[i]], function(pt) pt$clay)
  m <- sapply(df[[i]], function(pt) pt$sand)
  n <- sapply(df[[i]], function(pt) pt$silt)

  fig <- fig |>
    add_scatterternary(
      a = l,
      b = m,
      c = n,
      name = names(df)[i],
      mode = "lines",
      line = go_scatterternary_line(color = "#444"),
      fill = "toself",
      fillcolor = colors[i],
      showlegend = FALSE
    )
}

axis <- function(title) {
  go_ternary_axis(
    title = title,
    ticksuffix = "%",
    min = 0.01,
    linewidth = 2,
    ticks = "outside"
  )
}

fig <- fig |>
  update_layout(
    title = "Simple Ternary Contour Plot in R",
    ternary = go_ternary(
      sum = 100,
      aaxis = axis("clay"),
      baxis = axis("sand"),
      caxis = axis("silt")
    )
  )

fig

#Reference

See go_scatterternary() for more information and options!
